map.基于 VSS（Vancouver Scar Scale）标准，从色素、血管、柔韧: Based on the VSS (Vancouver Scar Scale) standard, assess the severity of hypertrophic scars and keloids from four dimensions: pigmentation, vascularity, pliability, and height.
map.温哥华瘢痕量表 VSS = 色素 P + 血管 V + 柔韧性 Pl + 高度: Vancouver Scar Scale VSS = pigmentation P + vascularity V + pliability Pl + height H (each 0 to 3), max 12; total ≤3 is mild, ≤7 is moderate, >7 is severe.
map.色素0-2、血管0-3、柔韧性0-5、高度0-3，总分0-13。分值越高，疤痕越: Pigmentation 0-2, vascularity 0-3, pliability 0-5, height 0-3, total 0-13. Higher score means more severe scar. Commonly used for burn and postoperative scar efficacy assessment.
map.📚 深度解析：疤痕(VSS)温哥华评分器: 📚 Deep Dive: Scar (VSS) Vancouver Scoring Tool
map.多维评估：录入瘢痕色泽（血管性/色素）、柔韧性（柔软→硬固）、厚度（0–3）、疼: Multidimensional assessment: enter the scar's color (vascular/pigmented), pliability (supple→firm), thickness (0-3), and pain and itch (each 0-3); the tool weights and sums the VSS.
map.疗效对比：激光、注射或术后复评，分值下降反映软化、褪色与症状缓解，辅助随访决策。: Efficacy comparison: re-score after laser, injection, or surgery; a falling score reflects softening, fading, and symptom relief, assisting follow-up decisions.
map.重点识别：定位最重维度（厚度或疼痛），指导点阵激光、瘢痕内注射等局部治疗重点。: Key identification: locate the most severe dimension (thickness or pain) to guide the focus of local treatments such as fractional laser and intralesional injection.
map.示例：瘢痕暗红（血管性高）、质硬、增厚 3mm、瘙痒 2 → VSS 汇总偏高，: Example: scar dark red (high vascularity), firm, thickened 3 mm, itch 2 → high summed VSS, suggesting comprehensive treatment focused on softening, fading, and symptom control.
